name: simplenote-mcp-server-evals
description: MCP evaluations for Simplenote MCP Server

scripts.eval:all: npm run eval:smoke && npm run eval:basic && npm run eval:comprehensive
scripts.validate:evals: node -e "require('fs').readdirSync('./evals').filter(f => f.endsWith('.yaml')).forEach(f => { try { require('yaml').parse(require('fs').readFileSync('./evals/' + f, 'utf8')); console.log('✅', f); } catch(e) { console.error('❌', f, e.message); process.exit(1); } })"
